svg.text: How data moves through the system.
Four representative flows: ordering, restaurant onboarding, rider pool claim, real-time fan-out.
Each step is one network call. Arrow colour matches the role initiating the call.
FLOW 01 — Customer places an order · initiated by customer
FLOW 02 — Restaurant onboarding · initiated by restaurant owner, approved by platform
FLOW 03 — Rider claims an order from the pool · initiated by rider
FLOW 04 — Real-time fan-out · any status change is pushed to every interested screen
Each circle is one network call (HTTP or SSE). Colour = role that initiated the call. Arrows show the order in time, not the size of the data.
All four flows share the same realtime fan-out: every state change is published to a channel, every screen subscribed to that channel updates within ~50 ms.
FOUR CALLS · FOUR ROLES · ONE STATE MACHINE
